# T-2: Apply batched gate execution

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Batch file-map requirement checks by identical related diff context within the character limit while preserving existing skip and fallback behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Requirements with identical diff context are checked in batches and agent call count is less than or equal to the number of checked requirements.
- Requirements whose multi-requirement batch would exceed the limit are split into multiple batches that stay within the limit.
- A single requirement whose indivisible related diff exceeds the limit is sent alone as an overflow batch bounded by the existing diff cap.
- Previously passed requirements and requirements with no related diff do not invoke the agent.
- The no-file-map path still performs one bulk requirement check.

## Implementation Notes
Use stable hashing for related diff context and unmapped diff contribution when grouping. Preserve parseImplRequirementEvaluation and gatePass/gateFail output shape. Do not weaken integration artifact trust checks before requirement evaluation.

## Test Strategy
Mock agent tests assert call count, requested ids, skip behavior, fallback behavior, and returned evaluation shape.
